note: The verse establishes the ethnic designation. Its historical connection with words for open country remains uncertain.
summary: פְּרִזִּי designates the Perizzite people. Genesis 13:7 uses the definite singular collectively and names them alongside the Canaanites.

senses.definition: A member of the Perizzite people. The definite singular can designate the people collectively.

evidence.note: הַכְּנַעֲנִי and הַפְּרִזִּי are paired singular gentilics naming the peoples then dwelling in the land.
